svg.title: US and Hong Kong books, measured apart
svg.desc: Us Book +91.75%, +US$2,286 on US$2,491 (true_principal). Hk Book −40.48%, −HK$42,675 on HK$105,427 (net_principal). Combined −19.79% in USD (mixed). Each return is total P&L (realized + unrealized) divided by the basis named under it; the bases differ and the currencies are not added. Daily total P&L per book from 2026-06-03 to 2026-10-06. Source: dashboard.json on the data plane.
